October 2, 2026

Q3 2026 Peptide News

The third quarter of 2026 brought notable momentum to peptide drug development, marked by an influx of oral peptide drug approvals, novel inhaled peptide delivery models, exciting advances in personalized cancer vaccines, and a welcome shift of attention toward women's health.

July 8, 2026

Q2 2026 Peptide News

The second quarter of 2026 has been a bustling period for peptide drug development, with continued growth in obesity and metabolic health and new developments in oncology and pain management. We’ve highlighted advancements spanning Phase 2/3 data in chronic weight management as well as targeted peptide treatments tackling oncology, rare bone disorders, and chronic inflammation.

May 7, 2026

Q1 2026 Peptide News

The start of 2026 has shown that the "Peptide Renaissance" is only accelerating. From the landmark approval of the first oral peptide for psoriasis to the massive expansion of the GLP-1 landscape, synthetic peptides continue to move from niche biologics to front-line primary care.

About Us

CSBio is a leading peptide instrumentation manufacturing company located in Silicon Valley, California.

CSBio provides research scale peptide synthesizers, pilot scale peptide synthesizers, commercial scale peptide synthesizers, and DNA/RNA oligonucleotide synthesizers.
